findings.title: Silence drawer never renders when only promRule is available (new ruler-less list view)
findings.body: The Silence menu item's visibility is now computed in AlertRuleMenu using the Grafana Prometheus rule ability (`useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`), which does not require a `rulerRule`. This means the 'Silence notifications' menu item is shown even when `rule` (the RulerRuleDTO) is undefined, which is exactly the case for the new ruler-less list view (GrafanaRuleListItem only passes `promRule`). However, in RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx the drawer itself is gated by `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`, which requires a truthy `rule` (rulerRule). When `rule` is undefined, clicking 'Silence notifications' sets `showSilenceDrawer` to true but the `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` never mounts, so the action silently does nothing. This breaks the silence feature for any consumer that only supplies `promRule` (i.e. the entire point of this PR).

findings.title: Missing key prop for Grafana rule items rendered in a list
findings.body: In the `rules.map()` call, the 'grafana' branch returns `<GrafanaRuleListItem rule={rule} groupIdentifier={groupIdentifier} namespaceName={ruleWithOrigin.namespaceName} showLocation={true} />` without a `key` prop, even though a `key` variable is destructured from `ruleWithOrigin` and used by the other two branches ('datasource' and default). Rendering a list without unique keys produces a React warning and can cause incorrect reconciliation/identity issues (lost component state, unnecessary re-mounts) especially since this list is updated incrementally via infinite scroll (`setRules((rules) => rules.concat(...))`).

findings.title: Rule view link no longer includes returnTo parameter
findings.body: The previous implementation (GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx, now removed) built the view URL with `createRelativeUrl(\`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view\`, { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`, allowing the rule detail page to show a 'back to list' link that returns to the exact filtered/paginated list state. The new `GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx` builds the href as `createRelativeUrl(\`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view\`)` with no `returnTo` param, and no longer imports `createReturnTo`. This silently drops the 'go back to previous view' UX for every rule rendered through this component (used by both FilterView and GrafanaGroupLoader), which is a behavior regression not mentioned in the PR description.

findings.title: Federated rule-group immutability check lost for the deprecated useAllAlertRuleAbilities hook
findings.body: Previously `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule)` computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` using the rule's actual group data, so rules in federated groups were correctly treated as immutable (Update/Delete/Pause/etc. disabled). After this refactor, `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule.rulerRule, groupIdentifierV2)`, which hardcodes `const isFederated = false;` (with a TODO comment to re-add support later). Since `useAllAlertRuleAbilities`/`useAlertRuleAbility` are still actively used elsewhere (e.g. by `RuleActionsButtons.tsx`/`RulesTable`, per the test file comments), this change silently removes the safeguard that disabled mutating actions on rules belonging to federated rule groups.

findings.title: Both ruler-based and Grafana-prom-based ability hooks are always evaluated
findings.body: `useRulerRuleAbilities` and `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` are both called unconditionally regardless of whether `rulerRule` or `promRule` is actually provided to the component. Each of these hooks performs its own folder lookups/permission computations (via `useIsRuleEditable` and `useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable`/`useFolder` respectively). For the common case where a full `rulerRule` is available (non-list views), the Grafana-prom ability path still runs (as long as promRule satisfies `prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule`), duplicating folder permission computation/requests that are already covered by the ruler-based path, and vice versa for the ruler-less list view. This adds unnecessary hook/query overhead on every render of the menu for Grafana-managed rules.
